title: EDS component contract
description: One component, one contract. The contract is the source of truth: the CSS and the Figma component set are renderers of it and never sync side-to-side. EDS-specific invariant: control heights are never authored — a part that declares `inset` derives its vertical padding optically from the part named by `opticalLabel` (padding = inset − halfLeading(label), so height = inset × 2 + cap(label)). Every fact an emitter consumes is dispositioned CARRIED, LOWERED, RESOLVED, or REFUSED — no silent loss, no invention.

notes.description: Open decisions and their cost-to-change. Human-facing.

anatomy.description: Marks this enum prop as the SIZE AXIS (at most one per contract): each value maps to anatomy parameters. The contract's anatomy literals describe the default value; other values re-derive insets, labels, icon glyph/footprint, pairings and geometry. label/inset are scale sizes; icon overrides the glyph size when it does not track the label.

proportion.description: Overrides the root inset's proportion for this size value (the table's compressed size drops squared to squished). Default: the root's proportion.

split.description: One code value writes SEVERAL Figma variant axes (the tooltip's placement → Side × Align — the Astryx factoring): the enum value splits on the separator; a missing tail part takes the pad value ('top' → Side=Top, Align=Center). The code attribute keeps the single compound value (ecosystem convention: Floating UI placements); only the Figma picker is factored.

attribute.description: Rendered as a data-* attribute named after the Figma property (ADR-0006 rule 3, 2026-08-30: variants and states are always data-* attributes, never modifier classes). The default value also matches the attribute's absence; booleans are valueless presence attributes. The token layer's ancestor mode scopes (data-density/data-color-scheme) stay reserved.

slot.description: Content, not styling — carried as element content.

pseudo.description: The enum lowers to a platform pseudo-class, never a class: the LAST enum value names the pseudo (checked -> :checked) and every other value is its negation. With a control part, read through the wrapper: :has(:checked).

inherit.description: The attribute CASCADES: the item also takes a value carried by ANY ancestor ([attr='v'] *) — one data-collapsed on the rail collapses every item; no per-item attribute needed. Figma cannot cascade into consumer slot content (instance content is the instance's own — the slots model): baked defaults mirror the variant, edited slots are flipped WITH the rail by multi-select. A recorded, bounded divergence.

variants.description: Token overrides pinned to specific prop values — for facts interpolation cannot express uniformly (e.g. on-emphasis text colors, the ghost ladder for transparent-resting variants). Keys are part/channel, optionally :state-suffixed (root/background-color:hover) to override a state per variant. Most-specific match wins. The border-color channel renders as an inside outline in CSS (width: sizing-stroke-thin, no layout shift) and an inside stroke in Figma.

structure.description: Structural overrides pinned to prop values — for variants whose anatomy differs, not just their colors (e.g. an icon-only round button). Facts here are still contract facts: both emitters consume them.

iconOnly.description: The sole visible part for these variants; text parts and other glyph parts are absent.

inset.description: Padding = the raw inset on all sides. With no text there is no half-leading to compensate, so the optical correction drops out and width = height = inset × 2 + cap: a circle under a pill radius.

interactiveOnly.description: The state exists only when the component is rendered as an interactive element: CSS gates the rule on :is(a, button) — no data-interactive attribute, the markup already says it (the card's hover). Focus needs no gate: a div cannot match :focus-visible.

when.description: Gate: the state only exists for combos matching these prop values (e.g. selected only for emphasis=muted — the token ladder has no emphasis-selected rung).

demo.description: Canvas demo data (tables need content to show a grid). CSS ignores it — markup is the consumer's.

tokenRef.description: DTCG path into packages/eds-tokens/tokens, braces included. `{prop}` segments interpolate over an enum prop's values.

when.description: Boolean prop gating this part's presence.

inset.description: Padding. Horizontal = inset-{size}-horizontal. Vertical is DERIVED: inset-{size}-vertical-{proportion} minus the half-leading of the part named by opticalLabel. Height is therefore inset × 2 + cap(label) — never authored. `proportion` is required unless `seat` is set.

opticalLabel.description: Part whose typography corrects the vertical padding. Omit for plain (uncorrected) insets.

seat.description: The container SEATS CONTROLS (a chrome strip: top bar, toolbars). Vertical inset = the SEAT rung of the spacing taxonomy (page xl → container md → cluster sm → seat xs), RAW — controls carry no half-leading, so optical compensation does not apply (the icon-only precedent). Height is emergent on both surfaces: tallest seated control + 2×seat (CSS content box, Figma hug). Replaces proportion and opticalLabel for the vertical axis; horizontal stays inset-{size}-horizontal.

figmaSlot.description: Figma-only: the part is the consumer's content area — a true SLOT node (Slots GA'd June 2026; the builder falls back to a dashed placeholder frame where the API is missing). Designers put as many children in as they want. CSS carries nothing: children of the root ARE the content, spaced by the root's gap.

seed.description: Figma-only demo content for a figmaSlot part: instances placed inside the slot as its default content. Same shape as `instance` (component + overrides).

element.description: TABLE parts: the part styles a DOM element inside the root (rows and cells cannot be classed per-instance). CSS: a nested element rule; Figma: lowered into the generated grid demo (column-major, so columns align).

corner.description: The part anchors to the root's upper-right corner (the banner's dismiss). CSS: align-self start + auto inline margin, with negative margins so the part's CAP BOX seats on the padding corner and the rest overflows like ink. Figma: absolute, top-right constraints, positioned so the part's icon container top-right = the padding corner (a bounded divergence: absolute offsets are not variable-bindable).

cluster.description: Names the CLUSTER this part belongs to — selectables acting as one group (the top bar's action row). Consecutive parts sharing a cluster name are wrapped, and the cluster's internal gap is the CLUSTER rung: sm, one rung below the container gap (Gestalt: within-group < between-group; optically, boxes that bring their own inset need less air added). CSS: a flex wrapper element `.eds-<cluster>` the consumer's markup groups; Figma: an auto-layout frame with the gap bound to spacing/horizontal-sm.

fill.description: The part absorbs the root's spare inline space — the CONTRACT owns the horizontal distribution (the top bar's identity leads, search and actions trail). CSS: margin-inline-end auto on the part — siblings after it trail to the inline end, the part's own box never stretches. Figma: the part FILLs and the set's variants get a fixed demo width so the distribution is visible (instances resize freely). A bounded divergence: auto margin vs FILL stretch — same seam, different mechanism.

overhang.description: How far a corner instance's box overflows its own cap box per side — the instanced component's OWN inset, declared here rather than assumed (e.g. the Button's inset-md-vertical-squished).

control.description: Marks the part as the NATIVE CONTROL inside a field wrapper (an <input> cannot contain children, so icon-bearing fields wrap it). The root renders as a plain wrapper; semantics.element names the control; CSS reads states THROUGH it — :has(:disabled), :has(:user-invalid), :focus-within — and the control itself is reset to inherit the wrapper's font, colour and inset.

pointer.description: Marks the part as the bubble POINTER (tooltip/popover arrow). It paints with the root background, its size derives from the label's cap box (width = cap, protrusion = cap/2 — density-scaling, never authored), and it sits on the edge opposite the placement, pointing at the anchor. CSS: a ::before pseudo-element positioned by placement modifiers. Figma: a triangle in an auto-layout wrapper, ordered and rotated per placement variant.

prop.description: The enum prop giving the placements: side[-align] values (top, top-start, right-end, …).

thickness.description: Marks the part as a RULE (e.g. a divider): its block-size is this sizing token and its ink is the background channel. CSS: block-size; Figma: a plain component with the height bound.

underline.description: Weight of the border-bottom underline (root only; defaults to sizing-stroke-thick when absent). CSS: the inset box-shadow offset; Figma: strokeBottomWeight, variable-bound.

width.description: Root only: an AUTHORED inline size — the rare owned dimension (the sidebar's 256). CSS: emitted as inline-size ONLY when no fill part exists (a fill part means the width is a demo strip, not the component's fact); Figma: the set's variants are built at this width (instances resize freely). When absent, a fill part alone gets the 1200 demo strip.

height.description: Root only: a Figma DEMO block size for containers whose real height is the app's (the sidebar). CSS: never emitted — the consumer owns it; Figma: the variants are built at this height so a filling slot has an edge to fill to.

collapsedWidth.description: Root only: the collapsed rail's width DERIVES from another contract's square edge — the matched item's height (inset×2 + cap), which is also that item's collapsed width. Applies to variants where the `collapsed` prop is 'true'. CSS: a live calc under [data-collapsed='true']; Figma: a minted recipe variable bound to the collapsed variants' width (RESOLVED).

matches.description: The contract id whose square edge this width matches (e.g. eds.side-bar-item).

endline.description: Weight of the border-inline-end edge (root only) — the sidebar's right border, the top bar's underline rotated. Colour from the border-right-color channel. CSS: an inset box-shadow so geometry is untouched; Figma: strokeRightWeight, variable-bound.

bleedGuard.description: Root only (floating panels): the panel pads its block ends by ITS OWN RADIUS — same token — so the items' full-bleed fills can never clip the rounded corners; the sides stay unpadded (items run edge to edge). CSS: padding-block from the radius ref; Figma: paddingTop/Bottom bound to the radius variable.

baseline.description: Root only, boxless text (captions, helpers): the text sits ON the baseline grid — a single line occupies exactly the cap cell (--eds-cap-rounded), n lines occupy capRounded + (n−1)·lineHeight, baseline at the box bottom. CSS: text-box trim-both ex alphabetic + padding-top round(1cap,4px)−1ex, @supports-gated (fallback: the untrimmed line box). Figma (the La Dupla mechanism): the text leadingTrim CAP_HEIGHT + FILL width, the root hugs with a FIGMA-ONLY top pad (figma-only/baseline-pad-<size> = 4px-grid cap − Figma's pixel-rounded cap per density, negative where the pixel cap exceeds the cell) — a minted value code must NEVER read. Both surfaces trim: a CARRIED fact, not a divergence.

indent.description: Root only: the leading inset is DERIVED from another contract — this part's label left edge aligns with the named contract's label left edge (parent inset + icon cap cell + icon gap). CSS: padding-inline-start as a live calc over the three tokens; Figma: a minted recipe variable (RESOLVED — Figma cannot calc).

alignsWith.description: The contract id whose label this indent aligns to (e.g. eds.side-bar-item).

flag.description: A small corner triangle indicator (the collapsed sidebar item's submenu mark). Legs = the xs spacing rung (density-scaling). Built ONLY in iconOnly variants; its `when` boolean gates visibility there. CSS: an ::after pseudo (clip-path triangle, ink from the part's color channel) — emitter-owned decoration, no markup; Figma: a corner-constrained vector.

glyph.description: The part's ink size (e.g. sizing-icon-md). Never resized — it overflows the footprint the way ascenders and descenders overflow the cap box.

footprint.description: The part's LAYOUT box (e.g. the label's cap box, recipe.cap-rounded-*). An icon is a glyph: it occupies a character cell. Carried by the part, so hiding the part removes its layout effect. CSS: margin = (footprint − glyph)/2 (negative). Figma: footprint-sized auto-layout container, glyph in flow, centered, clip off.

whenValue.description: Shows the part only for this enum-prop value (the enum sibling of `when`). CSS: the part is display:none under every other value's selector; Figma: hidden in every other variant. The control glyphs of checkbox/radio/switch swap this way.

instance.description: Composition-lite: the part IS an instance of another generated component (e.g. a Banner's action Button). CSS carries it as a SLOT (the consumer places the component's markup); Figma places an exposed instance of the named set's default variant, with optional property overrides.

overrides.description: Figma property overrides on the placed instance. An INSTANCE_SWAP override takes a 'key:<componentKey>' value — the builder imports and swaps.

icon.description: The @equinor/eds-icons export the instance's icon slot carries — the CODE side of a 'key:' swap override; the emitter masks the slot's empty .eds-icon span with it.

collapsedOverrides.description: Override entries applied ON TOP of `overrides` in variants where the Collapsed axis is 'true' (the sidebar's Collapse control faces the other way: first_page expanded, last_page collapsed). CSS carries the flip as a MIRROR on the pinned item's icon, because the two glyphs are horizontal mirror twins — one svg in the markup, scale: -1 1 under the collapsed attribute.

swapByProp.description: A glyph whose IDENTITY follows an enum prop (the banner's tone icon): one part, one class, a fixed glyph per value — never designer-swappable. Figma: each variant places the value's library component (mask+tint); CSS: the value's data-attribute selector sets --_mask to the icon's build-time data URI.

icon.description: The @equinor/eds-icons export name — the CODE side of the same icon.

swap.description: Figma-only content binding for a glyph part: an INSTANCE_SWAP component property, defaulting to the library component with this key (EDS Assets). CSS carries content as markup — the fact is LOWERED in Figma, CARRIED as a slot in code.

property.description: Omit to keep the icon FIXED (no INSTANCE_SWAP exposed) — control glyphs are not designer-swappable.

icon.description: The @equinor/eds-icons export name — the CODE side of the same icon. Single-element controls (checkbox/radio/switch) render it as a build-time mask-image data URI: background-color is the ink, the icon is the mask — the CSS twin of the Figma mask+tint.

tokens.description: Channel → token ref. Channels: background-color, color, border-color.
